chapterTitle: باب سوم: سیرتِ طیبہ و تاریخِ اسلام (Seerat-un-Nabi)
subject: islamiat-9

questions.question: Where was Prophet Muhammad ‫ ﷺ‬born?
questions.explanation: سیرتِ نبوی ﷺ اور تاریخِ اسلام کے مستند روایات کے مطابق درست جواب (C) 'Makkah' ہے۔

questions.question: Where was the first revelation sent down upon the Prophet ‫?ﷺ‬

questions.question: Who were the Ashra Mubashsharah?

options.A: The ten companions who participated in the Battle of Badr

options.D: The ten companions who migrated to Madinah
